subject: BlueCrest Enablement: joint craft sprint & field shadow plan
messages:
From: Ethan Li <ethan.li@bluecrest.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: partners@bluecrest.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership: Redwood field enablement pilot

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at RedCon — our team is excited about a closer integration for the consulting practice. We took a first pass at what a short, high-impact enablement engagement could look like (attached draft syllabus).

High-level ask: run a 3-week "craft sprint" with one of our delivery pods to certify BlueCrest engineers on Redwood deployment patterns (private VPC, dedicated routing policies, and canary rollouts). Program should include
- 2x half-day instructor-led sessions (day 1: infra & deployment, day 10: observability & rollouts)
- 3x shadow sessions: BlueCrest observes Redwood runbook-led customer onboarding (remote)
- A lightweight deliverable: integration checklist + two sample playbooks

We can fund a modest kickoff fee and want to understand Redwood delivery availability, expected owners, and whether you have a templated syllabus we can co-brand.

Attaching: bluecrest-syllabus-v1.pdf (draft)

Would you and your enablement lead be available for 30 minutes next week to align?

Best,
Ethan Li
Partnerships Lead, BlueCrest Consulting
E: ethan.li@bluecrest.com
T: +1 415-555-0182

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Ethan Li <ethan.li@bluecrest.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Redwood field enablement pilot

Ethan — great to hear from you and thanks for the draft syllabus. Happy to run a tight, outcome-focused craft sprint. High-level notes from me:

- We can cover private VPC and Dedicated routing in the first session; recommend including a short hands-on lab for the Dedicated pool provisioning (30 mins).
- Observability session should include Redwood Console walkthrough + a short exercise on tracing and cost breakdowns.
- Shadow sessions: we can schedule two live customer handoffs and one internal mock onboarding.

Owners: Marissa (Enablement PM) will co-lead the syllabus and run the lab content; Jonas (Partner Eng) will handle the Dedicated provisioning and integration checklist.

Next steps: 1) Marissa to review your draft and propose a finalized syllabus; 2) Vanessa to confirm dates and supply a Redwood integration checklist (see attached); 3) align on billing/kickoff fee.

I can do 10/12 or 10/13 at 10:00 PT for a 30-minute sync. Which works?

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Field Alliances, Redwood Inference
